name: RedKeysCoin
fix_description: Replace on-chain randomness (block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, block.coinbase, etc.) with a secure off-chain source like Chainlink VRF. All inputs to randomNumber() are known within the same block, allowing an attacker to pre-compute the result in their contract and only bet when they will win.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward predictable-randomness exploit: the PoC simply mirrors the target contract’s RNG logic on-chain, reads the counter, predicts the next outcome, and calls playGame in a loop. It’s a short single-pattern exploit with minimal protocol complexity and no flash loans, routing, or deep multi-contract reasoning.
